D: A family of undercover superheroes comes out of hiding to save the world.
P: Serve the mains at the chaotic family dinner.
S: Puffed corn tossed in butter, cheddar powder, smoked paprika and a pinch of mild chilli, baked until toasty and orange like a baby on fire. Heat the oven to 160C. Melt 50g butter and toss with 150g puffed corn snacks. Mix 3 tbsp cheddar cheese powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp garlic powder and a small pinch of mild chilli powder, and shake it over the corn until coated. Spread on a tray and bake 5 minutes until toasty. Cool 5 minutes before serving.
Grapes rolled in lime juice and sugar, frozen solid
Grapes picked off the stem, rolled in lime juice and caster sugar, spread on a tray and frozen solid for at least 3 hours.
Coconut panko prawns with a mango, chilli and lime dip
Prawns butterflied, dredged in flour, egg and panko mixed with coconut, fried at 180C for 2 minutes, mango and chilli dip.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf with tomato glaze, mashed potato and peas
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, glazed with tomato sauce, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.
Syndrome's island: when everyone's super, no one will be.

Eye fillet seared and rested with a glossy balsamic beef jus, creamy garlic potato gratin and buttered green beans with toasted almonds. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream warmed with 2 crushed garlic cloves, salt and thyme, and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Season 4 eye fillet steaks (200g each), sear 3 minutes a side and rest 5 minutes. Add 400ml beef stock and 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar to the pan and reduce to a glaze, then whisk in 20g butter. Blanch 300g green beans and toss with butter and 30g toasted flaked almonds.
W: Rich almond meal chocolate cake with a plain chocolate glaze
Dark chocolate torte (chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar, almond meal) baked at 160C for 35 minutes, glazed with ganache, perfectly plain.
K: Blended lemon and mint slush with a splash of lemonade, no alcohol

Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and mint blended with lots of ice into a frosty slush, topped with fizzy lemonade and a lemon wheel. Add 150ml fresh lemon juice, 120ml sugar syrup, 10 mint leaves, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, leaving a little room, and top each with a splash of cold lemonade. Garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.

s.note: Grapes rolled in lime juice and sugar, frozen solid
s.how: Pick 500g grapes off the stem, wash and pat dry. Roll in the juice of a lime, then in 50g caster sugar. Spread on a lined tray and freeze for at least 3 hours. Serve straight from the freezer in a chilled bowl.

s.note: Coconut panko prawns with a mango, chilli and lime dip
s.how: Butterfly 500g peeled green prawns, dip in flour, then 2 beaten eggs, then 60g panko mixed with 60g shredded coconut. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Blitz a mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.

m.note: Beef and pork meatloaf with tomato glaze, mashed potato and peas
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and a splash of Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for an hour. Serve with 1kg potatoes mashed and 300g peas.

w.note: Rich almond meal chocolate cake with a plain chocolate glaze
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, fold in the chocolate and 100g almond meal. Bake at 160C for 35 minutes and cool. Pour over 100g chocolate melted with 100ml cream. No decoration, no capes.

d.note: Blended lemon and mint slush with a splash of lemonade, no alcohol
d.how: Add 150ml fresh lemon juice, 120ml sugar syrup, 10 mint leaves, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 glasses, leaving a little room, and top each with a splash of cold lemonade. Garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.
